integrity_note: The infinite theorem is proved combinatorially and finite checks are supporting evidence. Originality remains a literature-based assessment, not a verified priority or independent certification. A 2002 publisher full text was inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Only single-hub bouquets with at least two cycles, each length at least three; not arbitrary cactus graphs. A 2026 generalized-series-parallel algorithm already computes both unrefined counts. The present formula refines by set cardinality and selected hub spokes and proves an exact modular DIM classification.
title: Hub-refined perfect-edge-domination polynomial and efficient domination of cycle bouquets
